newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MMK buys Reynolds' German packaging plant.
newsitem.headline: MMK buys Reynolds' German packaging plant.

text.p: Austrian cartonboard maker Mayr-Melnhof (MMK) said on Wednesday it had completed the purchase of Reynolds International's packaging plant in Trier, south Germany.
The purchase would bring in extra sales of 1.5 billion schillings, MMK said in a statement, but gave no time period.
MMK is Europe's largest producer of cartonboard and folding packages, while R.J. Reynolds is the world's third largest manufacturer of cigarettes with major brands Camel and Winston.

The plant in Trier has a manufacturing capacity of 30,000 tonnes of carton a year and employs 200 people. The Trier plant would remain the chief packaging deliverer for R.J. Reynolds International, MMK said.

"Working together with Reynolds, through which we gain entry into the market segment of cigarette packaging, is a quantum leap for Mayr-Melnhof," said MMK board member Alfred Fogarassy. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
